text: Epic implementation complete across P0-P7. ScalaFIM now has one MVPA module and one identified-evidence architecture: source plus purpose-specific design plus measurement frame plus typed estimand, compiled to a plan and AnalysisResult with receipt. Predictive and relational kernels share the waist; all retained analysis families lower through it. Legacy mvpa-fit, mvpa-dataset, mvpa-spatial, RoiAnalysis/Response/FoldPlan/FeatureSetPlan/RoiPayload/MvpaEngine surfaces are removed rather than adapted. All 82 tickets carry implementation/evidence records; clean admitted tree and final courts are recorded under P7.6/P7.7. No commit, push, remote CI, or publication was performed.
